title: Nifty Run: npm Scripts, Make & Task Runner
description: Everything you can run in one view: npm, pnpm and yarn scripts, make and just targets, Python and Go entry points, .NET, Cargo and Docker Compose. Run, debug or save to tasks.json.

title: Amaze Browser
description: A fast embedded Chromium browser inside VS Code, with DevTools, device emulation and live preview.

title: Lore Master
description: Gathers a project's lore: syncs the workspace's Markdown into a documentation platform (Confluence first).

title: Nifty Docstrings: Doc Comments for Python, PHP, Rust and Go
description: Type three quotes under a Python function and get a Google, NumPy or Sphinx docstring with its arguments, types, returns and raises. PHPDoc, Rust and Go doc comments too.

title: Nifty Shortcut Trainer: Learn Keyboard Shortcuts
description: Learn VS Code keyboard shortcuts while you work: spots slow habits like arrow-key walking or copy-paste duplicating and suggests the shortcut, plus a cheat sheet.

title: Nifty Workspace Keybindings: Per-Project Shortcuts
description: Keybindings per project: put them in .vscode/keybindings.json and they work only in that workspace, shared with your team through Git. Something VS Code doesn't do on its own.

title: Nifty Launch: launch.json Generator & Checker
description: Add debug configurations for what's in your project (npm scripts, tests, Python, Django, FastAPI, Go, .NET, Rust, browsers), build compounds, and catch broken launch.json references.

title: VhyxChart — animated diagrams
description: Live, animated architecture, flow, sequence and algorithm diagrams in Markdown preview and .vhyx files. Familiar diagram syntax with scenarios that move.

title: Transform — JSON Formatter, JWT Decoder & Dev Tools
description: JSON formatter & validator, JWT decoder, Base64 and timestamp hovers, JSON to TypeScript, Zod, Go, Python & Rust, YAML/CSV/TOML converter, UUID, hash and case tools. 100% offline.

title: Line Up
description: Rearranges selected lines in ascending order of length, from shortest to longest.

title: Status Quo
description: Show custom text in the status bar and change the status bar color.

title: CodeAtlas Architecture: Code Graph & Lens
description: 多语言代码架构资产全景认知中心 (Python / TypeScript / JS)，提供四层架构透镜、全景报告、拓扑流转与代码罗盘

title: Dark 2026 Minimal Purple
description: A minimal near-black VS Code theme with deep purple accents, based on Dark 2026.
